correctness.rationale: For a closed surface, 3f=2m and m=3(n-chi). Every original edge ab has two incident triangles abc,abd and defines indexed edge cd of the opposition multigraph. In the suspension double, base-edge vertex ab has four neighbors +c,-c,+d,-d: exact bipartite incidence graph with edge and duplicated vertex sides. Its component i has e_i+2v_i vertices, 4e_i edges and integral circle rank 3e_i-2v_i+1; summing gives 7n-9chi+q. Connected face-dual graph propagates the multiset of three opposition-component labels, hence q<=3 and exact triangle transversal counts 0,1,3; q=3 iff three-colorability. Sphere coloring by even-degree link propagation uses simply connected dual surface. Independently constructed tetrahedral/opposition and octahedral instances, confirming q=1,3 and their ranks/transversals; finite tests corroborate the general incidence proof.
residual_risks: For positive genus, vertex-degree parity is insufficient; source theorem correctly limits its converse to S^2.
